lines: I've got a bad feeling about this.
Let's get back to the ship
early today.
...Well, this is sudden.
I ran away from my teacher.
If I get caught, I'm in big
trouble. Come on, let's go!
Just for fun?! Oh, come on!
You're looking down on me
because I'm a kid!
I'm serious! I really
do want to be a sailor!
I believe you mean it. Remember
what I said? This voyage is serious
for us, too.
Life aboard is tougher than you
think. If you get sick of it, you
can't just get off halfway through.
Still, getting that close to Clau
is pretty impressive.
All right, all right.
Quit pulling my arm. You really
do have a temper...
What a mess. I knew
that bad feeling meant trouble.
Ahem! That's another one
of the Taoist arts!
...I remember wanting people to see
I could hold my own, too.
I heard you'd taken Yifa aboard.
I came to pay my respects
and have a word with you, if I may.
I am ashamed to say it, but
I failed to guide Yifa properly.
That's why she grew up so unruly.
Even if I wanted to, I couldn't.
She broke the law.
It's a grave offense.
Our school expelled her.
She still has so much to learn.
I worry she'll make a scene
in front of other people.
Was that a dream? It felt so real...
I can feel him! The senior student
I trained with!
His arts? Th-that
was one of his techniques?
There's something I want more
than anything. Lately I can't get
it out of my head, day or night...
Sounds expensive... Can I even
afford it? Where do they sell it?
That crown you were talking
about... What exactly
is the Silla Gold Crown?
A little. We don't even know
what it looks like,
and Julian's already gone
looking for it.
I'd be happy to get
it from you, too. Don't you think
I'm worth a gift?
(Clau's so easy to talk
into things.) All right, let's look
for it. You said Seoul, right?
Let's head for Seoul. We can
ask the locals once we're there.
We're looking for it. Can you tell
us anything about it?
Is everybody looking
for the Silla Gold Crown
these days? Somebody just asked me
the same thing.
Well, I couldn't tell if he wanted
information or if he was trying
to flirt with me.
They were so moved by my deep love
for you, Mihwa, that they let me
have it. Wasn't that kind of them?
Thank you. I really do owe it to
you. How can I ever repay you?
Mihwa! Are you here?
What are you so shy about now? You
said it right in front of Julian.
"I'll give it to her myself!"
Oh, she's lovely too. Her charm is
quite different from yours, Mihwa.
Don't you see? Finding
the Silla Gold Crown was my chance
to set out and see the world!
What's the world like? What about
my grandfather's birthplace?
I want to find out.
That's why I want to go.

row_proof: We can get to know each other.
Hold it! I'm talking to the boy.
We've still got a score to settle.
It'd be a shame if you died
I'll give you this much today.
You've got guts, boy. I like you.

That's a fine sword, boy. It'd look
better on me, though. I'll take
it off your hands one of these days.
Never mind, then. Come on, boys!

lines: ...Whew. We're safe.
